judge_context: One readable query, preferably with named CTEs that compute per-word aggregates once and pick the top synset with a window function (ROW_NUMBER over COUNT DESC, synsetid ASC) instead of repeated correlated subqueries. Consistent aliasing and indentation; no comments (task constraint) and no superfluous joins or columns.

case_items.name: Semantically equivalent, not just equal on this data
case_items.name_zh: 语义等价而非仅在当前数据上相等
case_items.question: Is /app/sol.sql semantically equivalent to /app/my-sql-query.sql for any database contents (same filters, NULL and duplicate handling, tie-breaking and ordering, LIMIT), without constants derived from the current data?

criteria.perfect: Preserves all semantics for any DB contents: HAVING thresholds, COUNT(DISTINCT ...) NULL behaviour, tie-breaks for the top synset (COUNT DESC, synsetid ASC), final ORDER BY with wordid tie-break and LIMIT 500, column aliases and types.
criteria.accept: Equivalent on all realistic data but relies on an incidental property (e.g. a NULL-free column or unique word per wordid) that the schema does not guarantee.
criteria.bad: Uses data-specific constants (hard-coded ids, thresholds or row lists), drops a tie-break, or changes NULL/duplicate handling so results could differ on other data.
